name: Kaya's Alive
label: Quest
description: In Stonetalon, Kaya Flathoof has survived the Grimtotem attack and reached safety. Makaba Flathoof sends you to Sun Rock Retreat with the news for her…

clips.title: The story
paras: In Stonetalon, Kaya Flathoof has survived the Grimtotem attack and reached safety. Makaba Flathoof sends you to Sun Rock Retreat with the news for her worried aunt, Tammra Windfield.

The Grimtotem strike along Stonetalon's contested trails. After their village fell under attack, young Kaya Flathoof was feared dead or captured by the renegades. Her rescue brings relief amid the fighting between tribes in the crags.

Makaba Flathoof sends you from Kaya to Sun Rock Retreat with word of her safety. Kaya's aunt, Tammra Windfield, waits there anxiously for news from the trails. Your message brings comfort to the family and keeps the remote Horde outpost connected.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! Kaya is alive! We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! That is good news indeed. Thank you, friend.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
